purpose: Binary Episodic TENT behavioral and license reference

upstream.name: Tent: Fully Test-Time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization

reference_files.role: reference for configuring BN affine adaptation and entropy-minimization updates
reference for optimizer construction and reset-oriented evaluation flow

preserved_principles: keep the model globally in evaluation behavior except for the selected BatchNorm protocol
make only BatchNorm affine weight and bias trainable
minimize prediction entropy at test time using an optimizer step
project_specific_differences: NS-FPN has one binary logit channel, so the objective is Bernoulli entropy of sigmoid(logit), not multiclass softmax entropy
v1 performs exactly one unconditional optimizer step per image and then executes a fresh post-update forward
every image begins from and returns to the exact Source model, optimizer, BN runtime, gradients, and RNG state
both current-image batch statistics (TENT-BS) and Source running statistics (TENT-SS) are exposed as separate mechanisms
Source-pre, TENT-mode-pre, and TENT-post predictions are retained separately
ground-truth labels never enter the adaptation method
